title: Isolate a worker's machine configuration
when: A launched worker initializes local state or changes connections
need: Select YOKE_MACHINE_HOME before configuration commands. It owns config.json and wins over a stale config-file override. Relay launches strip inherited YOKE_MACHINE_CONFIG_FILE; foreign writes refuse machine_config_not_owned with a recovery step, even when no home override is set.
surface: Config writer help and CLI/config machine-config home
review: Candidate subprocess tests cover Claude, Codex and Cursor child environments and preserve the steering configuration; deployed behavior remains unproven.
